devdoc.details: Trusts the Seer `MarketFactory` at `seerMarketFactory` for market clones, Reality      metadata, and CTF wiring.

params.factory: Seer market factory used for all market clones.

deploySession(((string,string[],string[].details: O(n) in the number of parent outcomes; each outcome triggers one Seer clone. TRUSTED.

returns.childMarkets: Seer scalar child clones in parent outcome order.

deploySessionChildBatch(uint256,(uint256.details: O(m) in batch size `m`; each entry triggers one Seer clone. TRUSTED.

params.childBatch: One or more child configs; indices must continue the stored sequence.

openPhasedSession(((string,string[],stri.details: O(n) in the number of parent outcomes for validation and config publication. TRUSTED.

EMPTY_WRAPPED_TOKEN_NAME.details: Third Seer wrapped token name slot is unused for scalar children.

NO_PARENT_MARKET.details: Parent markets are not linked to an existing parent market in Seer.

NO_PARENT_OUTCOME.details: Parent markets have no parent outcome index in Seer.

OMITTED_REALITY_METADATA.details: Seer accepts empty Reality metadata at this orchestration layer by design.

SCALAR_BRANCH_OUTCOME_COUNT.details: Seer scalar markets expose two branch outcomes (low / high).

SCALAR_UPPER_BOUND_HEADROOM.details: Seer reserves headroom below `type(uint256).max` for scalar branch encoding.

SEER_WRAPPED_TOKEN_NAME_SLOTS.details: Seer wrapped scalar tokens use three name slots (low, high, unused).

seerMarketFactory.details: Immutable reference; trust is deployment-time configuration. TRUSTED.

devdoc.title: SessionFactory

ChildBatchExceedsExpected().notice: Thrown when a phased child batch would exceed the expected child count.

InvalidConfig().notice: Thrown when deploy parameters fail structural or scalar bound checks.

InvalidSession().notice: Thrown when a session id is unknown or not yet allocated.

NotSessionDeployer().notice: Thrown when a phased child batch is sent by an address other than the deployer.

SessionAlreadyComplete().notice: Thrown when phased child batches are sent after the session is complete.

ChildMarketDeployed(uint256,uint256,addr.notice: Emitted when a scalar child market clone is created for a session.

ParentMarketDeployed(uint256,address,add.notice: Emitted when a parent market clone is created for a session.

PhasedSessionChildConfigPublished(uint25.notice: Emitted when phased deploy publishes the full validated child configuration.

constructor.notice: Binds this factory to a Seer `MarketFactory` deployment.

seerMarketFactory().notice: Seer market factory used for parent and scalar clones.

userdoc.notice: Permissionless orchestrator around Seer's `MarketFactory`: one categorical or         multi-categorical parent and one scalar child per parent outcome.
